faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about adoption, reporting, donations, and volunteering.
faq.faq1Question: How do I adopt a dog?
faq.faq1Answer: Browse our dogs page, read the profiles, and contact us by email. We will guide you through a short conversation and, if needed, a meet-and-greet with foster volunteers.
faq.faq2Question: How do I report a found dog?
faq.faq2Answer: Use the found-dog form with a photo and location if you can. Urgent cases reach our on-call volunteers faster than email. Approved reports may appear on the public map.
faq.faq3Answer: Donations fund food, vaccinations, emergency vet care, and foster support. Bank and crypto options are on the donate page. You can submit a donation report after you pay.
faq.faq4Answer: Yes — fostering, sharing reports, translating messages, and one-off transport help are all valuable. Email us to discuss what fits your schedule.
faq.faq5Answer: We are volunteers and usually respond within 1–2 business days. For urgent street cases, use the found-dog report rather than waiting for email.

about.title: About Dog Rescue
about.subtitle: We are a volunteer-driven group helping street dogs in Thailand find safety, care, and permanent homes.
about.missionBody: Every dog deserves food, medical care, and a chance at a stable life. We respond to reports from the community, coordinate rescue and treatment, and work with foster homes and adopters to give dogs a future off the street.
about.workItem1: Rescue and emergency care for dogs reported by the public.
about.workItem2: Foster care, vaccinations, and rehabilitation before adoption.
about.workItem3: Community reports on found and lost dogs, shared on our map after review.
about.helpBody: Donations fund food and vet bills. Sharing found-dog reports helps us act quickly. Adopting or fostering frees space for the next rescue.

stories.title: Rescue stories
stories.subtitle: Real dogs, real rescues — and the community that made a difference.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.subtitle: Questions about adoption, volunteering, or partnerships? Reach out — we read every message.
contact.hoursBody: We are volunteers and reply as soon as we can, usually within 1–2 business days. English and Thai supported.
